name: Parakeet Park
summary: Snow has fallen down in Parakeet Park! Hop on down and chill out with up to 19 your friends! Vibe to the holiday music, Go ice skating in the middle of the town, Dance with the parakeets around the town that grows almost every update! The world is ever changing, and you'll be able to meet new NPCs throughout the town! Stay warm out there, for it is chilly!
